SELECT f.id, f.organization_id AS organizationId, o.name AS organizationName, f.facility_type AS facilityType, f.name, f.address, f.phone, f.monthly_fee_min AS monthlyFeeMin, f.monthly_fee_max AS monthlyFeeMax, f.introduction, f.admission_conditions AS admissionConditions FROM facilities f JOIN organizations o ON f.organization_id = o.id WHERE f.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND f.facility_type = #{type}
AND ( f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT f.id AS id, f.organization_id AS organizationId, o.name AS organizationName, f.facility_type AS facilityType, f.name AS name, f.address AS address, f.phone AS phone, f.monthly_fee_min AS monthlyFeeMin, f.monthly_fee_max AS monthlyFeeMax, f.introduction AS introduction, f.admission_conditions AS admissionConditions FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN organizations o ON f.organization_id = o.id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE'
